name: Guangdong Fuxin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Fuxin Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, sale, and service of semiconductor thermoelectric devices, and thermoelectric systems and components in China and internationally.
